subject: English
question_text: Complete the story and give a suitable title to it.
stimulus: Once there lived two friends in a village. There seemed to be very intimate. They promised that they would help each other at the time of danger ................
guide_solution: Story writing Abir is an educated young man. After completing his M.A. he went to Dhaka in search of a job. He applied for various posts but he did not any. Being frustrated, he retuned his village home. He could not understand what he had to do one day, one of his best friends named Raju met him, and advised him to start a dairy farm. Raju was also interested to do that, as he had no job then. After a discussion, they deiced to start a dairy farm. Then the two friends went to the local agriculture office to get training on this sector. After the training, they tried to get a loan from a bank, and finally they got it. Thus the two frustrated friends got work by themselves. They tried hard and soul with all day long hardworking. Last year they made profit at about 5,00,000 Taka from their farm and now they are happy.  Title : Self help is the best help
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 111 — Barisal Govt. Girls' High School
